freeze_target: Phase 2 Stable Hermes for Platform Integration
purpose: Docs-only checklist for deciding whether Hermes can provide a stable platform integration baseline without claiming full Phase 2 closeout.
safety_rules: No raw platform reports, secrets, raw paths, raw DB rows, or customer data.
This checklist does not run runtime smoke.
This checklist does not close Phase 2 PRD or Roadmap metric gaps.
This checklist does not authorize production rollout.

items.description: Hermes name and enterprise agent kernel identity are stable for platform wording.
items.notes: Hermes must not be described as a generic platform chat plugin.

items.description: Gateway remains permission proof, project scope, path redaction, forbidden-field scan, and audit authority.
items.notes: Freeze must preserve current Gateway safety model.

items.description: Catalog-only asset query and asset_catalog_search remain the current platform-facing tool surface.
items.notes: Current stable surface is catalog-only, not document evidence search.

items.description: DWG/RVT/BIM/content questions return Missing Evidence when only catalog metadata exists.
items.notes: Catalog metadata must not become content evidence.

items.description: Safe IDs and trace refs are stable platform expectations.
items.notes: Safe refs include file_id, model_id, source_view, query_id, trace_id.

items.description: Low-sensitive memory boundary is defined as contract only.
items.notes: Memory continuity runtime/productization remains future; no raw content memory.

items.description: Feedback / eval linkage is review signal only.
items.notes: Feedback cannot auto-pass metrics, create facts, write memory, or trigger repair.

items.description: Platform single-turn plugin risk is documented and must not be accepted as product framing.
items.notes: Runtime session/thread/context refs remain future implementation, but platform must accept authority split before freeze.

items.description: Governed evidence layer is not productized.
items.notes: Stable freeze remains catalog-only; do not claim document_evidence_search runtime.

items.description: Eval inventory remains below PRD 100+ and Roadmap 300+ targets.
items.notes: This blocks full Phase 2 closeout, not the narrow platform stable baseline.

items.description: Top5 and citation metrics are not fully measured at target scale.
items.notes: Scoring machinery exists; target-scale reviewed result rows are missing.

items.description: Natural import / file governance usability evidence remains partial.
items.notes: User may decide this does not block platform stable freeze.

items.description: Test-machine update prompt exists for future stable baseline tag.
items.notes: Prompt uses placeholder <PHASE_2_STABLE_HERMES_BASELINE_TAG> until baseline is authorized.

items.description: Shared Hermes kernel authority contract is present and readable.
items.notes: No shared files were modified in Phase 2.106.

items.description: Production rollout, DWG/RVT/BIM content understanding, NAS semantic collection, Agent SQL/CRUD, repair executor, and full Data Steward productization remain out of freeze scope.
items.notes: Stable platform baseline must not be misread as Phase 3 transition.
